form.label: Stoker — Run Detail
form.description: A single run, keyed by run id: delivered vs target eps, pacing lag, HEC outcomes and lifecycle, then each worker slot against its share, with its engine's CPU against the container's allowance. Reached from the fleet dashboard or by entering a run id.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics run_id=$run_id|s$ | stats latest(state) as state

index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics run_id=$run_id|s$ | stats latest(reporting_workers) as reporting latest(live_workers) as live latest(unheld_slots) as unheld | eval v = reporting . " / " . live . if(unheld>0, " (" . unheld . " unheld)", "") | fields v
index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics run_id=$run_id|s$ | stats latest(eps) as eps
index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics run_id=$run_id|s$ | stats max(events_total) as events
index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics run_id=$run_id|s$ | stats max(bytes_total) as bytes | eval bytes = round(bytes/1024/1024, 1)

panel.title: Throughput — delivered eps vs target, and MB/s

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics run_id=$run_id|s$ | eval mbps = bps / 1048576 | timechart span=30s avg(eps) as "Delivered eps" avg(target_eps) as "Target eps" avg(mbps) as "Delivered MB/s"
index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics run_id=$run_id|s$ | timechart span=30s max(lag_s_max) as "Max pacing lag (s)"

index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics run_id=$run_id|s$ | timechart span=30s max(hec_2xx) as "2xx" max(hec_4xx) as "4xx" max(hec_5xx) as "5xx" max(hec_timeouts) as "timeouts" max(retries) as "retries"

index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:job run_id=$run_id|s$ | sort - _time | eval when = strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S") | table when from to end_reason degraded | rename when as "Time" from as "From" to as "To" end_reason as "End reason" degraded as "Degraded"

panel.title: Workers: each slot against its share (latest)
panel.description: One row per slot, from stoker:worker. Engine CPU is the generating process (100 = one core); "of limit" is that against the cores the container may use, so at 90 % or more the slot is CPU-bound and more rate needs more workers or a bigger CPU limit. A free slot has no worker holding it, so its share is not delivered.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:worker run_id=$run_id|s$ | stats latest(lease_state) as state latest(holder) as holder latest(engine_impl) as engine latest(share_eps) as share_eps latest(eps) as eps latest(eps_of_share_pct) as of_share latest(engine_cpu_pct) as engine_cpu latest(cpu_limit_cores) as cores latest(engine_cpu_of_limit_pct) as of_limit latest(engine_threads) as threads latest(lag_s) as lag_s latest(queue_depth) as queue latest(rss_mb) as rss_mb latest(heartbeat_age_s) as hb_age by slot | eval verdict=case(state="free", "unheld: no worker claimed this slot", state="lost", "lost: worker stopped heartbeating", hb_age>60, "silent for ".round(hb_age)." s", of_limit>=90, "engine CPU-bound", queue>0, "HEC queue backing up", lag_s>5, "behind schedule", isnotnull(of_share) AND of_share<90, "under share", true(), "ok") | eval eps=round(eps, 0), share_eps=round(share_eps, 0), lag_s=round(lag_s, 1), rss_mb=round(rss_mb, 0) | sort slot | table slot state verdict holder engine share_eps eps of_share engine_cpu cores of_limit threads lag_s queue rss_mb | rename slot as "Slot" state as "Lease" verdict as "Verdict" holder as "Holder" engine as "Engine" share_eps as "Share eps" eps as "Delivered eps" of_share as "% of share" engine_cpu as "Engine CPU %" cores as "CPU limit" of_limit as "% of limit" threads as "Threads" lag_s as "Lag s" queue as "Queue" rss_mb as "RSS MB"
index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:worker run_id=$run_id|s$ lease_state=running | eval slot="slot ".slot | timechart span=30s avg(eps) by slot limit=50

panel.title: Engine CPU by slot (% of the container's limit)

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:worker run_id=$run_id|s$ lease_state=running | eval slot="slot ".slot | timechart span=30s max(engine_cpu_of_limit_pct) by slot limit=50
